label: Lembert Studio
title: Games Worth Playing
standfirst: An exploration of what we are capable of creating.
paragraphs: We have a lifetime to play.
We can spend it mastering a craft, building a company, raising a family, exploring the unknown, or creating something that would not otherwise exist.
What fascinates me is our capacity not only to play games, but to invent them. To create new possibilities, commit ourselves to them, and discover who we become in the process.
A game worth playing is not merely one worth winning. It is one worth dedicating a part of your life to.
One that expands you. One that calls something out of you and out of the people around you. One that makes something available in the world that was not there before.
Lembert Studio is where I play these games with others.
We explore. We inquire. We create. We develop mastery. We produce results.
And we enjoy finding out what we are capable of.
